newsitem.title: USA: U.S. 1996/97 Sugar stocks/use ratio 14.0 pct-USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. 1996/97 Sugar stocks/use ratio 14.0 pct-USDA.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department forecast Tuesday a 1996/97 sugar stocks-to-use ratio of 14.0 percent, a key figure in setting the import quota.

At the start of fiscal 1997, USDA allocated 1.7 million tonnes of sugar imports with adjustments to be considered in January, March and May. If the ratio is 15.5 percent or less on the review dates, the quota automatically goes up 200,000 tonnes. If it is higher, the tranche is cancelled.
